BASE.name: ATTACK_VECTOR
BASE.justification: The cross-site request is sent from another web site over the network.

BASE.name: ATTACK_COMPLEXITY
BASE.justification: The attack only works when no other CSRF protection is in place.

BASE.name: PRIVILEGES_REQUIRED
BASE.justification: No account is needed to host the attacking page.

BASE.name: USER_INTERACTION
BASE.justification: The victim must visit the attacker page while logged in.

BASE.name: SCOPE
BASE.justification: The impact stays within the vulnerable application.

BASE.name: CONFIDENTIALITY
BASE.justification: The attacker cannot read the response.

BASE.name: INTEGRITY
BASE.justification: The attacker can perform actions on behalf of the victim.

TEMPORAL.name: EXPLOIT_CODE_MATURITY
TEMPORAL.justification: The vulnerability class is well documented and proof-of-concept exploits exist.

TEMPORAL.name: REMEDIATION_LEVEL
TEMPORAL.justification: The rule description documents the secure coding fix.

TEMPORAL.name: REPORT_CONFIDENCE
TEMPORAL.justification: The issue is identified by static analysis of the vulnerable code pattern.
